1: 'מתני MISHNA: Everyone slaughters - Everywhere that [the tanna] teaches "everyone," in each instance he brings the halacha from the beginning of tractate Arakhin and explains (Arakh. 2a:4), "Everyone  [makes valuations], to include whom?" And "everyone slaughters," which is taught in the Mishna, the amoraim argue about it in the Gemara to [ultimately] say, "to include an impure person [slaughtering an animal] for mundane use," and to say, "to include a Samaritan or a heretic."
וכולן And all of them - In the Gemara it is explained who are "and all of them."
